title: Composition-RL: Compose Your Verifiable Prompts for Reinforcement Learning of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.12036v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale verifiable prompts underpin the success of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), but they contain many uninformative examples and are costly to expand further. Recent studies focus on better exploiting limited training data by prioritizing hard prompts whose rollout pass rate is 0. However, easy prompts with a pass rate of 1 also become increasingly prevalent as training progresses, thereby reducing the effective data size. To mitigate this, we propose Composition-RL, an offline data-augmentation approach that composes existing prompts before RL to address the pass-rate-1 bottleneck without modifying the RL optimizer. The composed dataset is generated and verified once from the fixed source pool and then used for RL training. translated_title: Composition-RL：为大型语言模型的强化学习组合你的可验证提示
translated_abstract: 大规模可验证提示是可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）取得成功的基础，但其中包含许多无信息量的样本，且进一步扩展的成本高昂。近期研究专注于通过优先选择通过率为0的困难提示来更好地利用有限的训练数据。然而，随着训练的进行，通过率为1的简单提示也日益增多，从而降低了有效数据规模。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了Composition-RL，这是一种离线数据增强方法，它在强化学习之前组合现有提示，以解决通过率为1带来的瓶颈，而无需修改强化学习优化器。组合后的数据集从固定的源数据池中生成并验证一次，随后用于强化学习训练。在4B至30B不同模型规模上的大量实验表明，Composition-RL在推理能力上始终优于在原始数据集上进行强化学习训练的效果。性能可以……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 提出Composition-RL这一离线数据增强方法，通过在强化学习之前组合现有可验证提示来解决通过率为1的数据瓶颈，在不修改RL优化器的情况下持续提升大语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Composition-RL is an offline data-augmentation approach that composes existing verifiable prompts before reinforcement learning to overcome the pass-rate-1 bottleneck, consistently improving LLM reasoning without modifying the RL optimizer.
